notes: Fixes the button added in 1.17.27, which could not work: it read whichever window was in front, and clicking a button in RecCheck puts RecCheck in front. It now looks for protel's in-house window itself. The list only has to be OPEN — it does not have to be in front, on top, or even visible. Still read-only, and still nothing sent to protel beyond the getters the read needs.
